title: Prospective economic evaluation of a predictive artificial intelligence model for sepsis: Effects on hospital costs and return on investment.
summary: The primary paper evaluates deployed BIAlert-Sepsis and associates its implementation with resource-use and cost changes; nonrandomized before–after design precludes causal attribution.
ai_technology: retrospective quasi-experimental comparison of 6,168 baseline and 1,871 implementation-period sepsis patients, with COVID period excluded; GLM and interrupted time-series/economic analyses. Published abstract reports lower ICU use and costs, but causal attribution is limited by before–after design and mature sepsis program.
